method.signal: per-decision GROSS return vector of each ANCHOR (and NEIGH for the ancestry panel) built exactly per the proposal representation_identity on the frozen S4 H1 panels; pooled across the 3 symbols in symbol-major chronological order; A5 vectors include the declared settlement transfer -d*rate(S) verbatim where the representation books it
method.cost_invariance: r_net = r - 2c with constant c per arm: Pearson is invariant to additive shifts and Spearman to monotone transforms, so every rho below equals the after-cost rho at ANY tier constant; no cost constant invented
method.veto_alignment: hourly vetoes evaluated on the decision bar (closed and PIT at the decision close; the A5-P1 decision bar is B-2, the A5-P2 decision bar is B); daily vetoes dated D = the decision bar's UTC date (inherited V17 exposure-vs-proxy convention)
method.dead_form_shadow_convention: the dead ng1 FOMC forms are rendered as RETURN shadows on the measured proposal's own fills: the dead rule's direction is evaluated at each decision bar and compounded over the SAME entry/exit bars as the measured row (the strict same-bet test; rho > 0.20 = re-clocking of a dead shape)
method.statistics: pooled Pearson + Spearman (average-rank ties); veto bar |rho| > 0.2; margin = bar - max|rho|; pairs need n >= 8 aligned rows and non-zero variance on both sides, else recorded UNMEASURED with a reason
method.identifiability_bar: clock shadow / shifted placebo |rho| < 0.98 vs the anchor (a twin control makes the battery uninterpretable; SFV12-A5-H1 class)
method.pnl_ban: no expectancy, PF, PnL or any aggregate of returns is computed in this artifact; raw return vectors are NOT embedded (reproducible from code + frozen panels + pinned funding data)
